mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS noticeId, writer_admin_id AS writerAdminId, notice_type_code AS noticeTypeCode, title, content, view_count AS viewCount, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt, TO_CHAR(deleted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS deletedAt, important_yn AS importantYn, pinned_yn AS pinnedYn FROM NOTICE WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN pinned_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC, notice_id DESC

SELECT notice_id AS noticeId, writer_admin_id AS writerAdminId, notice_type_code AS noticeTypeCode, title, content, view_count AS viewCount, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt, TO_CHAR(deleted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS deletedAt, important_yn AS importantYn, pinned_yn AS pinnedYn FROM NOTICE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT notice_attachment_id AS noticeAttachmentId, notice_id AS noticeId, original_name AS originalName, stored_name AS storedName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM NOTICE_ATTACHMENT WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY notice_attachment_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET notice_type_code = #{nidto.noticeTypeCode}, title = #{nidto.title}, content = #{nidto.content}, important_yn = #{nidto.importantYn}, pinned_yn = #{nidto.pinnedYn}, updated_at = TO_DATE(#{changedAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE notice_id = #{nidto.noticeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE NOTICE SET deleted_at = TO_DATE(#{changedAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), updated_at = TO_DATE(#{changedAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_NOTICE_HISTORY.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO NOTICE_HISTORY ( notice_history_id, notice_id, writer_admin_id, notice_type_code, title, content, view_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, changed_by_admin_id, actor_type_code, actor_id, change_type_code, change_reason, valid_from, valid_to, important_yn, pinned_yn, notice_attachment_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size ) VALUES ( #{noticeHistoryId}, #{noticeId}, #{writerAdminId}, #{noticeTypeCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{viewCount}, TO_DATE(#{createdAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(#{updatedAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(#{deletedAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{changedByAdminId}, #{actorTypeCode}, #{actorId}, #{changeTypeCode}, #{changeReason}, TO_DATE(#{validFrom}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(#{validTo}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{importantYn}, #{pinnedYn}, #{noticeAttachmentId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize} )
mapper.select:
SELECT notice_history_id AS noticeHistoryId, notice_id AS noticeId, writer_admin_id AS writerAdminId, notice_type_code AS noticeTypeCode, title, content, view_count AS viewCount,
TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt, TO_CHAR(deleted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS deletedAt, changed_by_admin_id AS changedByAdminId, actor_type_code AS actorTypeCode, actor_id AS actorId, change_type_code AS changeTypeCode, change_reason AS changeReason,
TO_CHAR(valid_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS validFrom, TO_CHAR(valid_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS validTo,
important_yn AS importantYn, pinned_yn AS pinnedYn,
notice_attachment_id AS noticeAttachmentId, original_name AS originalName, stored_name AS storedName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize
FROM NOTICE_HISTORY WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY notice_history_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE_HISTORY SET valid_to = TO_DATE( #{changedAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND change_type_code IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') AND valid_to IS NULL
